description: Early spring forest ambience Netherlands. MORE IN THIS PACK. Insects around and birds sing. Natural reserve Kampina in The Netherlands. A beautiful day in the early spring of 2019. The microphones are on the edge of a small quiet stream called "Rosep". This is an area of dunes, fens and forest. 150 meters away is a marsh / fen (Belversven) with geese. Date/time: March 22nd Friday 2019, 12 – 1PM Weather: 16c, clear sky, wind S 2bft, 14 kmh max., 1028 hPa, humidity 40%, sun intensity 592 W/m2. Location; Oisterwijkse bossen en vennen, river Rosep, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe.
